description.describe_ch: This course covers various discrete methods and techniques for representing non-continuous matters, and introduction to a field of practically useful mathematics. Topics include the set theory relations and functions, finite state machines, the principle of inclusion and exclusion, recurrence relations, the principle of counting, and graph theory.

Topics include the set theory relations and functions, finite state machines, the principle of inclusion and exclusion, recurrence relations, the principle of counting, and graph theory.
